analysis:
Both units are BASE-side text of docs/architecture/inference.md (lines 2034-2597). The PR is documentation-only: a date bump, GLM5 video wording that variable-frame-rate tracks are now indexed at i / nominalFrameRate instead of refused, and additions near lines 876-895 and 1732-1751 that are outside my supplied units. No code, wire protocol, key custody, attestation or authorization changes are visible in what I examined.

The visible base text describes existing controls: MiMo and Flint memory admission, context-limit checks, encrypted SSD prefix-cache reuse (T-041/SEC-035), media-prefix exclusion, coordinator-authored cache scope, and fail-closed tool and constraint validation. None of these is weakened by the PR.

The one security-adjacent change is the GLM5 video VFR behavior. It moves from a deterministic 400 to acceptance, which depends on the unchanged decoded-frame cap (maximumDecodedBytes, 512 MiB) and the 28,532 visual-token cap. The supplied excerpt shows only a doc description, and no source code was supplied to check that those bounds still hold for VFR inputs. That is an unverified contract, not a finding.

I did not see the new doc text at head lines 876-895 and 1732-1751, so integration should confirm those additions do not claim stronger guarantees such as qualification, secrecy or encryption. They should also not loosen the T-041 statements about TTL, scope or salt. The coordinator-side prompt sidecar and the GLM5 processor implementation are outside the supplied evidence.
